technicalContent.whyUsed: Textile wastewater contains high negative colloidal turbidity and suspended solids that do not settle naturally without coagulants.
technicalContent.howItWorks: High positive cationic charge neutralizes negative zeta potential of colloidal particles, allowing them to collide and form micro-flocs.

Decolourization rate on water-soluble hydrolysed reactive, acid, and direct dyestuffs

Floc settling velocity and dewatering cake compactibility on filter press equipment
Minimal impact on treated effluent discharge pH and total dissolved solids (TDS)
